rules.categories: Building priority: non5->5 new, 5->non5 demolition, 5->5 rebuilt; both in {1,3} vegetation (including same-class change); 2<->{1,3} surface/vegetation; remaining transitions containing 4 water; all remaining GT transitions other.
rules.main_table: Unique added TP and remaining FN attributed by each pixel GT transition. All newly added FP go to 无类. Baseline FP are not newly added FP. Overlapping units counted once by their union.
rules.sensitivity: Assign each accepted whole unit by its most frequent GT (t1,t2) pair, ties lexicographic; no GT overlap -> 无类. Remove/keep whole units of that class, then reconstruct union with baseline. Pixels covered by another class remain after removal. These unit classes differ from pixel classes in the main table; F1 changes are not additive.
rules.two_b: Replay exp2_compose box variant: semantic-transition GT objects, best predicted-component IoU <0.1, prompted objects only; choose highest GT-IoU date in prompt view order, ties first.
rules.five_c: Read saved exp6 local piece masks, kind=recall, sources B/G0.05[/H1], area>=10, recomputed whole-piece GT fraction >=0.5. Check stored geometry/purity, then full-test historical gains.
rules.tolerance: 0.01 percentage point for gains +7.81/+6.96/+8.50 and absolute F1 against historical JSON. Integer count differences are recorded (exp2 historically omitted tiny GT on unprompted images).
rules.boundary: batch16 boundary = mask minus 3x3 erosion with outside=0; Euclidean tolerance 2; micro counts.
